gen-gf-paprika-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Paprika spaces its big, loud letters far apart, with lowercase that stands as tall as capitals. Atkinson Hyperlegible then reads steadily down the page, its wide-set s and clipped ascenders keeping long paragraphs friendly and clear.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic: Loud, loosely spaced display letters up top. Paprika does its best work shouting a few words; Carrois Gothic, with a generous c opening and a high-set x-height, does its best work carrying the details.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Commanding and expressive, Paprika scatters its letters wide. Carrois Gothic SC lays down open curve endings and almost no height difference between capitals and lowercase, which makes the text feel approachable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-fresca: Expressive and commanding, Paprika scatters its letters wide, while Fresca stays modern and clean, its apertures keeping counters open to outside space. Loud personality up top, uniform strokes without calligraphic thinning below.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-funnel-sans: Paprika brings a loud, scattered swagger up top, its lowercase standing as tall as capitals. And Funnel Sans, a sans-serif with uniform strokes and a widely opened e, holds the quiet half of the bargain.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-geist: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with a lowercase that stands up like capitals and counters that breathe. Geist hums level and quiet below, its words solid blocks against that shout.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-georama: Paprika scatters its loud letters far apart. Georama settles underneath with a wide-open c and barely rising capitals, so the text gets room to breathe while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-golos-text: Paprika is all expression, loud letters scattered wide with a lowercase that stands up like capitals. Golos Text does the opposite job, with an x-height that fills the line and strokes built to carry text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads tall and sturdy, with wide gaps where curves meet stems and strokes that never swell or thin. Under Paprika's loud headings, long paragraphs move along steadily.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-siliguri: Paprika sprawls, its letters scattered and its lowercase tall. Hind Siliguri sits beneath it as a sans-serif of constant line weight, with a gentle bump up to capitals, giving the shouting heading a steady companion.
